data.name: Marwaah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Marwah', meaning 'graceful' or 'tender'. In Islamic tradition, Marwaah is the name of a woman mentioned in the Hadith who offered water to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) during his journey from Makkah to Madinah.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes kindness, compassion, and nurturing qualities. It is believed that a child named Marwaah will grow up to be a gentle and loving individual.
data.numerology_meaning: Represents harmony, balance, and love. People with the life path number 6 are natural nurturers, and they are often drawn to careers that involve caring for others.
